title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context. This page belongs to the unpublished continuation of La Longue Marche, 'variations sur l'équation des lacets'. The notation fits a rank-one reductive setting, though this page does not state it. Probably G = GL2 (or a group with centre G_m), SG = its special (derived) subgroup, PG = its adjoint quotient, and G an extension of PG by G_m. For given data ρ, σ (presumably prescribed conjugacy or monodromy classes in the loop equation), Grothendieck has defined subgroups R_{ρ,σ} = Ker Θ̃ and SR_{ρ,σ} = Ker Θ inside groups M_{ρ,σ}. The superscript ° denotes their neutral components. ST_ρ, ST_σ are one-dimensional 'special' tori. T_{ρ,σ}, T^+_{ρ,σ} and their neutral components are tori, or tori extended by μ2×μ2.

Previous page. It gave a prism (95) whose three lateral squares are both cartesian and cocartesian. The vertical quotients are μ2×μ2 and the horizontal quotients are G_m, PG and G. It derived the exact sequence 1 → SR° (≅ ST_ρ×ST_σ) → R_{ρ,σ} → G_m×μ2×μ2 → 1. This page opens by saying that this sequence 'makes explicit the structure of R_{ρ,σ} in terms of the very simple groups ST_ρ, ST_σ, G_m, μ2'.

The cube. He builds a cube on the back-left vertical face of (95).
- Back face: SR → R (cokernel G_m) over SR° → R° (cokernel G_m), with vertical cokernels μ2×μ2.
- Front face: S T^+_{ρ,σ} → T_{ρ,σ} (cokernel G_m) over T^{+°} → T° (cokernel G_m), again with vertical μ2×μ2.
- The four diagonal (front-to-back) arrows are group morphisms.
  - The two out of SR and SR° (towards T^+ and T^{+°}) have trivial kernel; in the image the second appears to carry a '2'.
  - The two out of R and R° (towards T and T°) have kernel μ2.
  - On the G_m quotients the induced map is λ ↦ λ².
- Front and back faces are cartesian and cocartesian.

Intersections with SG (97). The kernels translate into:
- R_{ρ,σ} ∩ SG = R°_{ρ,σ} ∩ SG = μ2;
- SR_{ρ,σ} ∩ SG = SR°_{ρ,σ} ∩ SG = {1}.

Proof sketch, finished on the next page.
- For the first line, μ2 = SR°… ∩ SG ⊂ R ∩ SG. Also R ∩ SG = Ker(Θ̃|SG), and Θ̃|SG = Θ̃°|SG is the canonical isogeny SG → PG, whose kernel is μ2.
- For the second line, Θ|SG is the inclusion SG ⊂ G, so SR ∩ SG = {1}.
- The isomorphisms SR ≅ T^+ and SR° ≅ T^{+°} ≅ ST_ρ×ST_σ follow from earlier formulas and the five lemma.

Purpose. This is a structural lemma: it describes the stabiliser-type subgroups R_{ρ,σ} attached to the loop equation via tori and μ2 data. It is used next to exhibit a second splitting of M^+_{ρ,σ} as an extension of T^+ by SG.
errors: The machine transcription garbles (97). The image reads, first line, R_{ρ,σ}∩SG = R°_{ρ,σ}∩SG = μ2 (the leading S of the first term is struck), and, second line, SR_{ρ,σ}∩SG = SR°_{ρ,σ}∩SG = {1}. The transcription instead writes SR∩SG on the first line and makes it equal to μ2, which contradicts the second line.

No mathematical error is visible. The argument is fragmentary on this page (several crossed-out attempts) and is completed on the next page. The marginal NB on the previous page flags a pending surjectivity check onto μ2×μ2, which this page does not settle.

ideas.what: A cube of algebraic groups whose faces are bicartesian (cartesian and cocartesian), with kernel bookkeeping: μ2 versus trivial kernels, and λ↦λ² on the G_m quotients.
ideas.modern_name: Structure of centralizer/stabilizer subgroups via isogenies of tori; bicartesian squares of group extensions

ideas.what: Computing R∩SL2 = μ2 and SR∩SL2 = 1 using the isogeny SL2 → PGL2 with kernel μ2.
ideas.modern_name: Center of SL2; kernel of the adjoint isogeny
ideas.where_published: SGA3 treats such isogenies in general

deep.surprise_reason: This is routine structural bookkeeping for subgroups attached to the loop equation in a rank-one reductive group (probably GL2). It is careful and correct, but it is technical lemma work with no evident novel result or connection.
transcription_corrections: (97), first line, should read: R_{ρ,σ} ∩ SG = R°_{ρ,σ} ∩ SG = μ2, with the leading S struck through.
(97), second line: SR_{ρ,σ} ∩ SG = SR°_{ρ,σ} ∩ SG = {1}.

Cube diagram: the diagonal arrow labels near SR and SR° are heavily crossed out. The lower one appears to carry '2', and the R → T and R° → T° diagonals are labelled μ2. The dashed G_m → G_m arrows on the right are labelled λ ↦ λ², and the vertical arrows are labelled μ2×μ2.
Last line: 'μ2 = SR°_{ρ,σ} ∩ SG ⊂ R_{ρ,σ} ∩ SG', with 'Ker Θ' written under SR°.
